articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear celebrates scoring the winning goal for Middlesbrough against Lincoln.
images.alt: Middlesbrough's Will Lankshear celebrates scoring their side's second goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Riverside Stadium, Middlesbrough. Picture date: Saturday August 15, 2026.
images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.
images.alt: Middlesbrough's Will Lankshear (right) celebrates scoring their side's first goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Riverside Stadium, Middlesbrough. Picture date: Saturday August 15, 2026.
images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP
articles.description: Australia international Nestory Irankunda will feature in the UEFA Champions League this season after joining Portuguese giants Sporting CP.

images.name: Nestory Irankunda [1296x729]
images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Premier League, EFL summer transfer window 2026 dates: When is Deadline Day?
articles.description: Everything that Premier League and EFL supporters need to know about the 2026 summer transfer window, and key dates around it.

images.name: Liverpool's Harvey Elliott during the Premier League match between Liverpool FC and Brentford FC [1296x729]
images.credit: Photo by Dave Howarth - CameraSport via Getty Images

images.name: Olley: Tottenham have to go 'all-in' to back De Zerbi in transfer window
images.caption: James Olley looks ahead to Tottenham's summer transfer window with Roberto De Zerbi.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn
articles.description: Returning hero Raúl Jiménez rescued a point for Wolves at the death as they drew 2-2 with Blackburn in the Championship's curtain-raiser at Molineux.

images.name: Jimenez celeb [1296x729]
images.caption: Raúl Jiménez scored a late goal on his return to Wolves.
images.alt: Raul Jimenez of Wolverhampton Wanderers applauds fans after the Sky Bet Championship 2026/27 match between Wolverhampton Wanderers and Blackburn Rovers at Molineux on August 14, 2026 in Wolverhampton, England.

articles.headline: Dastan Satpayev signs Chelsea deal, joins Burnley on loan
articles.description: Chelsea's teenage forward Dastan Satpayev joined Burnley on a season-long loan on Friday after signing a six-year contract with the west London club.

images.name: Dastan Satpayev Chelsea [1296x729]
images.caption: Dastan Satpayev featured for Chelsea during their preseason tour.
images.alt: Chelsea's Dastan Satpayev celebrates scoring a goal during the Sydney Super Cup football match between Chelsea FC and the Western Sydney Wanderers at Stadium Australia in Sydney on July 28, 2026
images.credit: Saeed Khan / AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Nicol: Pedro will score goals for Chelsea under Alonso next season
images.caption: Nicol: Pedro will score goals for Chelsea under Alonso next season

articles.headline: Wrexham sign Sunderland's Anthony Patterson in potential record deal
articles.description: Wrexham have signed Sunderland goalkeeper Anthony Patterson in a deal that sources told ESPN could eventually break the club's transfer record.

images.name: Anthony Patterson [1296x729]
images.alt: Anthony Patterson, goalkeeper of Sunderland warming up on the pitch before the Premier League match between Sunderland and Everton at Stadium of Light on November 3, 2025 in Sunderland, United Kingdom.

article.headline: Sheffield United cruise past Bristol City to book playoff final spot
article.description: Sheffield United cruised into the Championship playoff final after goals from Kieffer Moore, Gustavo Hamer and Callum O'Hare produced a 3-0 win over Bristol City at Bramall Lane on Monday, securing a 6-0 aggregate success in the one-sided semi-final.

article.story:
Sheffield United cruised into the Championship playoff final after goals from Kieffer Moore, Gustavo Hamer and Callum O'Hare produced a 3-0 win over Bristol City at Bramall Lane on Monday, securing a 6-0 aggregate success in the one-sided semi-final.

United will face the winner of the second semi-final in the playoff final at Wembley on May 24 with Sunderland leading Coventry City 2-1 ahead of the second leg of their tie at the Stadium of Light on Tuesday.

Moore headed in United's opener in the first half before Hamer's shot took a wicked deflection and wrong-footed goalkeeper Max O'Leary. O'Hare added a late third as he swept the ball into the net unchallenged in the 83rd minute.

United were relegated from the Premier League at the end of last season having managed only three wins in 38 games. They finished third in the 2024-25 Championship season, behind Leeds United and Burnley, who earned automatic promotion.

First Half ends, Sheffield United 1, Bristol City 0.
Second Half begins Sheffield United 1, Bristol City 0.
Goal! Sheffield United 2, Bristol City 0. Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield United) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Harrison Burrows following a corner.

Substitution, Bristol City. Marcus McGuane replaces Max Bird.
Substitution, Bristol City. Yu Hirakawa replaces George Earthy.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Rhian Brewster replaces Andre Brooks.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Callum O'Hare replaces Thomas Cannon.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Tyrese Campbell replaces Kieffer Moore.
Substitution, Bristol City. Sam Bell replaces Cameron Pring.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Jesurun Rak-Sakyi replaces Gustavo Hamer.
